It serves businesses, passenger transportations, educational and medical institutions, utilities and fire services, agricultural, and various industries. The company was formerly known as Open Joint Stock Company GAZ and changed its name to Public Joint Stock Company "GAZ" in June 2016. The company is based in Nizhny Novgorod, Russia. Public Joint Stock Company "GAZ" operates as a subsidiary of Russkie Mashiny OOO.

Public Joint Stock Company "Novolipetsk Steel" manufactures and sales steel products in Russia and internationally. It offers hot-rolled and cold-rolled products; hot-dip galvanized and pre-painted steel products; electrical steel products, including non-grain oriented and grain-oriented; and semi-finished and by-products, such as raw material, recycled, and waste recycling. The company was founded in 1931 and is based in Moscow, Russia. Public Joint Stock Company "Novolipetsk Steel" operates as a subsidiary of Fletcher Group Holdings Limited.

Public joint stock company "Ozon Pharmaceuticals" develops, manufactures, and markets pharmaceutical products in Russia. It offers gefitinib for protein kinase inhibitors; epidermal growth factor receptor tyrosine kinase inhibitors; sunitinib for protein kinase inhibitors and other protein kinase inhibitors; lenalidomide for thyroid preparation; flutamide for antiandrogen; capecitabine for antimetabolite; anastrozole for estrogen synthesis inhibitor; tacrolimus for calcineurin inhibitor; imatinib for protein tyrosine kinase inhibitor; bicalutamide for antiandrogen; azathioprine for immunosuppressants; and skinoclear cream and gel for acne treatment. The company was founded in 2001 and is based in Samara, Russia.

company: Public Joint Stock Company Interpipe Novomoskovsk Pipe Production Plant
business_description: Public Joint Stock Company Interpipe Novomoskovsk Pipe Production Plant manufactures steel electric-welded pipes. It offers pipes for gas and oil trunk pipeline and general applications. In addition, it provides enameled tableware; and medium-diameter oil pipes, small-diameter carbon pipes, and profiles enameled dishes, as well as insulating anti-corrosion coating services. The company was founded in 1935 and is based in Novomoskovs'k, Ukraine. Public Joint Stock Company Interpipe Novomoskovsk Pipe Production Plant is a subsidiary of Interpipe Limited.

Public Joint Stock Company KuibyshevAzot, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture, distribution, and sale of various chemicals in Russia, Asia, rest of Europe, and internationally. The company operates through Caprolactam and Derivatives, and Ammonia and Nitrogen Fertilizers segments. It offers anhydrous liquefied ammonia, ammonium nitrate, urea, ammonium sulphate crystalline and granular, UAN, ammonium nitrate containing sulfur, sulfur-containing nitrogen fertilizer brand, liquid nitrogen fertilizer, nutrient solution containing sulfur, and ammonia aqueous, as well as caprolactm, polyamide-6, engineering plastics, and polyamide-6 secondary. The company provides technical and textile threads, impregnated nylon cord and anid cord fabric, and polyamide and mixed fabrics; industrial chemistry substances, comprising cyclohexanone and cyclohexane technical, POD oil purified, alkaline effluent from caprolactam production, solvent SFPK, soda ash, polymer raw materials, and heptane fraction; and industrial gases, such as argon liquid, argon gas, nitrogen and oxygen, and food grade carbon dioxide. It is involved in the transportation of finished goods; sale of construction materials; investing; sale of electric power; capital construction; production of engineering plastics and synthetic fibers; and the provision of rental services. The company was formerly known as KuibyshevAzot Joint Stock Company and changed its name to Public Joint Stock Company KuibyshevAzot in November 2016. The company was founded in 1961 and is based in Togliatti, Russia.

company: Public joint stock company NPO Nauka
business_description: Public joint stock company NPO Nauka engages in the manufacture and sale of aerospace equipment in Russia and internationally. It offers fans, moisture separators, dampers, valves, dehumidifiers, pneumatic and pneumo-electric control and monitoring devices, pressure regulators, heat exchangers, turbo refrigerators, air cooling units, filters, air ejectors, electric compressors and heaters, and electric devices, as well as electronic control and monitoring units, alarms, and regulators. The company also provides after sales support and repair, design support and author’s supervision, conducting tests, polymer coatings, rent, verification of measuring instruments, test center, and testing and control laboratory services, as well as sells equipment from the vacated territory and unclaimed components. Public joint stock company NPO Nauka was founded in 1893 and is based in Moscow, Russia.

Public Joint Stock Company Severstal, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells steel products. The company offers hot rolled steel, hot rolled products with a diamond-shaped and lentil-shaped corrugation, heavy plates, plates and tubes, hot rolled pickled steel, cold rolled steel, galvanized steel, galvanized steel with colored anti-corrosion coating, electric welded round steel tubes, shaped tubes, special tubes, large diameter pipes, steel plate for pipes, pies for oil platforms, steel plate for piles, and wind turbine towers. It also provides steel plate for wind turbine towers, wire rods, round bars, grinding balls, reinforcing bars, shaped rolled products, ropes, cold drawn steel and steel shaped profiles, steel fibre, cut wire shot, fasteners, meshes, nails, and wire, as well as pre-painted galvanized steel for roofing systems, sandwich panels, and facade solutions. Its products are used in construction, energy, and mechanical engineering, as well as automotive, consumer electronics, railway machinery, energy and petrochemical equipment, lifting and rigging equipment, industrial packaging, farming equipment, shipbuilding and armored vehicles, bulk goods and heavy equipment, and electrical engineering sectors. The company was formerly known as Open Joint-Stock Company Severstal and changed its name to Public Joint Stock Company Severstal in December 2014. Public Joint Stock Company Severstal was founded in 1955 and is headquartered in Moscow, Russia.

company: Public joint stock company TEPLANT vostok
business_description: Public joint stock company TEPLANT vostok produces and sells building structures and materials for rolled metal products in Russia. It provides wall and PIR sandwich panels, metal tiles, roofing, wall, corrugated board, painting rolled steel, shaped elements, strips, and related products, as well as block container and mineral wool insulation. The company was formerly known as Public joint stock company "Chelyabinsk plant of the profiled steel decking" and changed its name to Public joint stock company TEPLANT Vostok in March 2025. Public joint stock company TEPLANT vostok founded in 1974 and is based in Chelyabinsk, Russia. Public joint stock company TEPLANT vostok operates as a subsidiary of AO Stroysistema.

Pure Biologics S.A., a biopharmaceutical company, engages in the research and development of biological drugs and medical devices for therapeutic use. Its therapeutic portfolio in the field of immuno-oncology includes PB003G, which targets the GARP-TGFß1 complex; PB004, an anticancer drug based on an anti-ROR1 antibody; and PB003A, a therapy that targets the aVß8 integrin. The company was founded in 2010 and is based in Wroclaw, Poland.

PVA TePla AG, together with its subsidiaries, offers systems and solutions to produce components for energy storage systems, photovoltaic modules, and wind turbines worldwide. The company operates through Semiconductor Systems and Industrial Systems segments. The Semiconductor Systems segment provides solutions and systems for the semiconductor industry, including crystal growing systems, metrology systems for quality control, and plasma systems for removing surface contamination from wafers. The Industrial Systems segment offers solutions and systems for the production and refinement of materials; surface treatment; and monitoring production processes configured primarily for the needs and requirements of other industrial areas, such as the medical, electrical, and tool industries. The solutions are used in semiconductor technology, mobility, aerospace, automotive industries, materials science, and the renewable energy industry. The company has its operations in Germany, France, Italy, Switzerland, the United States, China, Taiwan, Korea, and Singapore. It also provides services comprising product and process development, soldering, welding, and heat treatment. The company was founded in 1977 and is headquartered in Wettenberg, Germany.

PZ Cussons plc manufactures, distributes, markets, and sells baby, beauty, and hygiene products in Europe, the Asia Pacific, the Americas, and Africa. The company offers toiletries, pharmaceuticals, electrical goods, edible oils, fats and spreads, nutritional products, shampoos, body washes, toothpastes, toothbrushes, skin and hair care products, food pouches, cereals, snacks, flavors, and fragrances; beauty soaps, lotions, wipes, creams, shower gels, foam-bursts, bar soaps, deodorants, bath infusions, handwashes, and conditioners; ointments; dishwashing liquids, tablets, gels, capsules, rinse aids, liquid detergents, laundry soaps, and laundry solutions; and cooking and vegetable oils. It sells its products under the Bayley’s of Bond Street, Canoe, Carex, Charles Worthington, Childs Farm, Cussons Baby, Cussons Kids, Devon King’s, Fudge Professional, Fudge Urban, Haier Thermocool, Imperial Leather, Joy, Mamador, Morning Fresh, Original Source, Premier Cool, Radiant, Rafferty’s Garden, Robb, Sanctuary Spa, St.Tropez, Venus for You, and Zip brand names. The company was formerly known as Paterson Zochonis Plc and changed its name to PZ Cussons Plc in 2002. PZ Cussons plc was incorporated in 1884 and is headquartered in Manchester, the United Kingdom.

QleanAir AB (publ) provides air cleaning solutions for indoor environments in Sweden and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Air Cleaners, Cabin Solutions and Cleanrooms. It offers freestanding air cleaners for professional environments; freestanding smoking cabins for protection against secondhand smoke; and freestanding room-within-a-room turnkey cleanroom solutions under the QleanAir and QleanSpace names. The company’s solutions are used in warehouses and logistics centers, schools, offices, high security facilities and institutions, transport and airports, hotels, casinos, and restaurants, as well as food, manufacturing, assembly, aerospace, healthcare, drug preparation, pharmaceutical, manufacturing, BioTech, Offshore, shopping malls, Production, MedTech, and life science industries. The company was formerly known as QleanAir Holding AB (publ) and changed its name to QleanAir AB (publ) in July 2021. QleanAir AB (publ) was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Solna, Sweden.

R. STAHL AG, together with its subsidiaries, develops, manufactures, assembles, and distributes devices and systems for measuring, controlling, and distribution of energy, securing, and lighting explosive environments worldwide. It offers luminaires, including linear luminaires, tubular light fittings, emergency luminaires, floodlights, pendant light fittings, wall and ceiling mounted bulkhead light fittings, helideck systems, and hand lamps; junction and terminal boxes; and control boxes, such as temperature controllers and limiters, control equipment for panel mounting, control stations for industrial, and thermostats. The company provides control systems and distribution boards comprising lighting and heating circuit distribution boards, load disconnect switches, motor protection circuit breakers, safety switches, uninterrupted power supply products, machine controls, and battery boxes, as well as direct-on-line motor, star delta, and soft starters. In addition, it offers health management information systems (HMIS) which includes barcode readers, radio frequency identification readers, panel personal computer/thin clients, KVM classic, operator interfaces, panel-mount devices, ethernet extender, configurable software, and HMI finder; mobile solutions and mobile devices; and CCTV systems and cameras. Further, the company provides automation interfaces and solutions for safety barriers, isolators, remote I/O, fieldbus technology, ethernet-APL filed switches, grounding systems and monitoring devices, Ex p products, and network technology products. Additionally, it offers cable glands, components, and enclosures products; visual and audible signaling devices, and control devices; and plugs and sockets, and connectors. The company serves its products to oil and gas, chemical, marine and shipbuilding, pharmaceutical, machine, food and beverage, and other industries. R. STAHL AG was founded in 1876 and is headquartered in Waldenburg, Germany.

Radici Pietro Industries & Brands S.p.A. offers textile flooring for offices, residential, and commercial establishments; and professionals in the cruise, ferry, and yacht sectors worldwide. It develops and manufactures artificial turf for sports and landscape applications. The company also provides customizable textile accessories for vehicles, offering tailor-made solutions, as well as operates an e-commerce platform for rugs and artificial turf. It offers its products under the Radici Carpet, Radici Marine, Radici Sports, and Radici Automotive brands. The company was founded in 1950 and is headquartered in Cazzano Sant'Andrea, Italy. Radici Pietro Industries & Brands S.p.A. is a subsidiary of Miro Radici Family of Companies s.p.a.

RATH Aktiengesellschaft, together with its subsidiaries, produces and sells refractory materials for industrial customers and commercial enterprises in Austria, Germany, Hungary, the United States, and internationally. The company offers oxide ceramic continuous fibers under the ALTRA FLEX brand; dense bricks, such as acid-resistant bricks, firebricks, high-alumina fireclay bricks, high-alumina bricks, sillimanite/andalusite bricks, corundum bricks, and silicon carbide bricks under the Acrath, Suprath, Durrath, Alurath, Silrath, Korrath, Sicrath, and RATHLOC brands; and monolithics consisting of dense concretes, mortars and adhesives, plastic castables, mortars for dense bricks, insulating and cement-free concretes, ultra-low and low cement concretes, and adhesives for materials made of high-temperature wool under the Carath, Porrathin, Carathplast, Carathin, and Kerathin brands. It also provides pre-cast blocks under the Carathform and Vibrorath brands; insulating fire bricks under the Porrath, Ratherm, and Porrathin brands; high temperature insulation wool under the Altra, Altraflex, Alsitra, and Calsitra brands; and vacuum-formed shapes under the Altraform, Kerform, Evac, Newvac, Filtrath, Ultiform, and ACS ALTRA brand name. In addition, the company offers planning, installation, construction site supervision, and maintenance and repair services. Its products are used in the cement, steel, glass, aluminum, special furnaces, hot-gas filtration, ceramic, energy, fuels and chemical, and domestic fireplaces industries. The company was founded in 1891 and is headquartered in Vienna, Austria. RATH Aktiengesellschaft is a subsidiary of Rath Holding GmbH.

Ratti S.p.A. manufactures and distributes fabrics and accessories for clothing, shirts, ties, underwear, beachwear, and furnishings; and distributes packaged products, mainly men's and women's accessories in Italy, Europe, the United States, Japan, and internationally. It operates through Polo Ratti Luxe; Polo Rainbow; Polo Carnet; Studio; Furnishings; and Polo Art segments. The company offers printed, jacquard, plain, and yarn-dyed fabrics for clothing, shirts, ties, underwear, beachwear, and furnishings; accessories for women and men, including squares, foulards, shawls, stoles, scarves, ties, pocket squares, and hats; and textiles and accessories for the upholstery fabrics, curtains, and home accessories. It also produces and markets wax fabrics. It serves its products under Elie Saab, Givenchy, Lanvin, Léonard Paris, and Ungaro brand names. The company serves tailors, designers, emerging stylists, garment makers, and service companies. It sells its products through gifting, e-commerce, and retailers. Ratti S.p.A. was founded in 1945 and is headquartered in Guanzate, Italy.

Rawlplug S.A. design, manufacture, and sells fixings, fasteners, and tools under KOELNER, RAWPLUG, and MODECO EXPERT brands in Europe and internationally. It offers cordless and electric power tools, and power tool accessories; concrete and steel nail guns; accessories for nail guns and concrete; clips, washers, and tapes for nail guns; and building, mechanical, basic, cutting, measuring, connection, painting, and garden tools, as well as glue and glue guns, belts, health and safety articles, and tool transport accessories. The company also provides chemical resin fixings and mechanical anchors; wall plugs; frame, hammer, plasterboard, ceiling, facade, and roofing fixings; construction, wood, decking, drywall, self-drilling and tapping, steel, and frame screws; threaded roads, bolts and accessories, nails, wires, and hooks; and sealants, adhesives, expanding foams, polyurethane mortars and adhesives, silicones, and primer paint. In addition, it offers angle brackets, frame ties, brackets, special connectors, galvanized bands, latches and hinges, and building fittings; chains, steel wire and PVC coated steel, jute and polypropylene twisted ropes, elastic ropes, cords, and accessories; and radiator, curtain pole, outside light, gate, mirror, shelving, stairs, TV, hanging basket, and sanitary solution kits. Further, it wholesales construction materials; goods warehousing; develops building and property projects; generates and distributes electricity from renewable energy sources; and offers investment and technical support services. It serves construction, automotive, energy, road, wood, machinery, electrical machinery, and mining industries. The company was formerly known as Koelner S.A. and changed its name to Rawlplug S.A. in 2013. Rawlplug S.A. was founded in 1887 and is headquartered in Wroclaw, Poland. Rawlplug S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Amicus Poliniae Sp. z o.o.

Read-Gene S.A. engages in the detection, prevention, and treatment of various types of cancer. Its activities include chemoprevention, clinical tests, and genetic tests. The chemoprevention segment engages in the use of natural or synthetic substances to inhibit, reverse, or delay the process of cancer. The company conducts clinical trials in cancer patients; and provides genetic tests and genetic oncology consultations to all patients for the most common cancers, such as breast, ovarian, prostate, stomach, and colon cancer. It also provides consulting services for planning and support for oncology genetic clinics; and operates an online platform. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Dobra, Poland. Read-Gene S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Gen-Pat-Med Sp. z o.o.

REC Silicon ASA, together with its subsidiaries, produces and sells silicon materials for the solar and electronics industries in Norway and internationally. It provides various Signature Silane gas, a pure form of silicon that produces product for fuel industries comprising specialty gases, including Dichlorosilane, Monochlorosilane, and Disilane for use in the manufacturing processes of flat panel displays, semiconductors, and solar cells; and solar grade polysilicon, including NextSi used for multi crystalline and monocrystalline solar ingot and wafer production in the manufacturing of solar modules. The company also provides electronic grade polysilicon consisting of float zone-based devices are used in motor control and power conversion processes for hybrid and electric vehicles, wind energy, and high voltage transmission, 5G communications, high-speed trains, internet of things, and big data, as well as Czochralski for manufacturing of semiconductor wafers used in memory processors, optics, and micro electromechanical systems. The company was formerly known as Renewable Energy Corporation ASA and changed its name to REC Silicon ASA in October 2013. REC Silicon ASA was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Lysaker, Norway.

company: Recordati Industria Chimica e Farmaceutica S.p.A.
business_description: Recordati Industria Chimica e Farmaceutica S.p.A., together with its subsidiaries, researches, develops, produces, and sells pharmaceuticals in Italy, the United States, Spain, France, Germany, Russia, Ukraine, Turkey, Portugal, North Africa, and internationally. It operates through Specialty and Primary Care; and Rare Diseases segments. The company develops Maapliv for maple syrup urine disease; Isturia for endogenous Cushing’s syndrome; Cystadrops treatment of the ocular manifestations of cystinosis; Carbaglu for hyperammonemia due to n-acetyl glutamate synthase deficiency; Qarziba for neuroblastoma patients and patients with relapsed or refractory neuroblastoma; and Fotivda for renal cell carcinoma. It also develops Sylvant for idiopathic multicentric castleman diseases; Caphosol for oral mucositis; ENJAYMO for hemolysis in adults with cold agglutinin disease; Zanidip, Zanipress, Vazkepa, and Logimax for hypertension; Urorec and Avodart for symptoms of benign prostatic hyperplasia; and Livazo for dyslipidemia; Combodart/Duodart; Seloken for angina pectoris, myocardial infarction and cardiac rhythm disorders, as well as hypertension and functional heart disorders. In addition, the company offers Procto-Glyveno for internal and external hemorrhoids; Polydexa, Isofra, and Otofa for ear, nose and throat infections; Isturisa, for Cushing’s syndrome; Normosang, human hemin; Juxtapid, homozygous familial hypercholesterolemia;Ledaga, mycosis fungoides, T-cell cutaneous lymphoma;Tergynan, an anti-infective for gynecological infections; CitraFleet and Phosphosoda as bowel cleansers; Lomexin for gynecological and dermatological infections; Hexaspray, treatments for the oral cavity; Magnesio Supremo, a dietary supplement; Reaglia for schizophrenia; Eligard for hormone-dependent prostate cancer; and pasireotide in Phase II trial for patients with post-bariatric hypoglycemia, as well as other products. The company was founded in 1926 and is headquartered in Milan, Italy.

As of April 1, 2020, redT energy plc was acquired by Avalon Battery Corporation, in a reverse merger transaction. redT energy plc, together with its subsidiaries, develops and supplies energy storage machines based on proprietary vanadium redox flow technology for on and off-grid applications. It provides vanadium redox flow machines, solar + storage corporate PPA solutions, and hybrid energy storage systems. The company also offers research and consultancy, and business services. It operates in the United Kingdom, European Union, Australia, Asia, and sub-Saharan Africa. The company was formerly known as Camco Clean Energy plc and changed its name to redT energy plc in November 2015. redT energy plc is based in St Helier, Jersey.

Remor Solar Polska S.A. engages in design and implementation of projects to install photovoltaic ground and roof structure systems in Poland. The company is also involved in the development, design, and construction of photovoltaic farms. Remor Solar Polska S.A. was incorporated in 2011 and is based in Recz, Poland.

Renault SA engages in the design, manufacture, sale, repair, maintenance, and leasing of motor vehicles in Europe, Eurasia, Africa, the Middle East, the Asia Pacific, and the Americas. The company operates through Automotive, Sales Financing, and Mobility Services segments. The Automotive segment produces, sells, and distributes passenger cars and light commercial vehicles. The Sale Financing segment is involved in the sales financing, rental, maintenance, and service contracts under the Mobilize Financial Services trade name. The Mobility Services segment provides mobility and energy solutions for electric vehicle users under the Mobilize Beyond Automotive brand. It offers used vehicles and spare parts; and engages in the business-to-business powertrain activities, and research and advanced engineering activities. The company also engages in the design and production of parts and equipment used for manufacturing and operation of vehicles. It serves commercial, light commercial and passenger vehicles, tractors, farm machinery and construction equipment under the Renault, Dacia, and Alpine brands. The company was founded in 1898 and is based in Boulogne-Billancourt, France.

RENK Group AG engages in the design, engineering, production, testing, and servicing of customized drive systems in Asia, Germany, the United States, Africa, Australia, Oceania, and other European and European Union countries. The company operates through three segments: Vehicle Mobility Solutions, Marine & Industry, and Slide Bearings. It offers single and dual engine gearboxes; marine gearboxes, clutches, and bearings; shaft generators; hybrid and electric, and onboard power grid solutions; transmissions, engines, final drives, suspension systems, and track tension; and electrification and hybrid mobility solutions. The company also provides helical, planetary, integral, vacuum, and clutch gearboxes; variable speed systems; and industrial gearboxes for mills, extruders, and hydropower plants. In addition, it offers slide bearings, couplings, and test systems. The company also provides engineering, condition monitoring, maintenance and modernization, and spare parts management services; mechanical and gear manufacturing, hardening, and metrology services; marine services, including evaluation and design of propulsion system, and power distribution and grid design; design of suspension for military vehicle; and spare parts management, contract manufacturing, and test systems. The company serves military vehicles, marine, civil maritime, cement and plastics production, and oil and gas industries, as well as customers in hydrogen, energy generation, carbon capture, utilization and storage, and industrial heat pump applications. RENK Group AG was founded in 1873 and is headquartered in Augsburg, Germany.

Reploid Group AG engages in the processing of organic waste into raw materials. Its products include animal proteins and fats for wild bird, chickens, and rodents; insect-based meat for pet food production; and organic fertilizers for plant growth and health. Reploid Group AG was formerly known as REPLOID Value Solutions GmbH. The company was founded in 2020 and is headquartered in Wels, Austria.

Respiratorius AB (publ), a research company, develops pharmaceuticals for the treatment of cancer. The company’s products under development include VAL001, that is in Phase III clinical trials for the treatment of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma; and VAL001, a product candidate that is in preclinical phase for the treatment of relapsing diffuse large B-cell lymphoma. Respiratorius AB (publ) was incorporated in 1998 and is based in Lund, Sweden.

RHI Magnesita N.V., together with its subsidiaries, develops, produces, sells, installs, and maintains refractory products and systems used in industrial high-temperature processes worldwide. The company offers magnesite and dolomite, and refractory bricks, as well as mixes, mortars and castables, and functional specialized refractory products. It also provides refractory engineering solutions, such as drawings or design of a linings concept, installation, supervision, maintenance, and recycling. In addition, the company offers systems, sensors, machinery, and digital products; and sells internally produced raw materials, such as magnesite ore, dead-burned magnesia, and fused magnesia. Additionally, it offers raw magnesite, caustic magnesia, sintered magnesia, dolomite and sintered dolomite, magnesia products, slag conditioners, magnesium oxide, spinels, agalmatolite, chromite, grogs, and commodities. The company serves customers in steel, cement, metals, lime, non-ferrous metals, glass, energy, environmental, and chemicals industries. RHI Magnesita N.V. was founded in 1834 and is headquartered in Vienna, Austria.

RhoVac AB, a pharmaceutical company, develops and commercializes drugs for the treatment of cancer in Sweden and Denmark. Its primary product candidate is RV001, an immuno-oncologic drug, which is in phase IIb clinical phase to identify and destroy cells that carry metastatic or metastatic potential cells. The company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Lund, Sweden. As of January 18, 2023, RhoVac AB was acquired by Chosa ApS.

Rieter Holding AG, together with its subsidiaries, supplies systems for manufacturing yarn from staple fibers in spinning mills in Switzerland and internationally. It operates through three segments: Machines & Systems, Components, and After Sales. The company develops and manufactures machinery, systems, and components for converting natural and man-made fibers, as well as their blends into yarns; planning and ancillary services; and develops, produces and distributes spinning systems and single machines. It also offers products, including fiber preparation, spinning preparation, ring spinning, compact spinning, rotor spinning, air-jet spinning, automation, digitization, winding, and texturing machines, as well as related components. In addition, the company supplies technology components to spinning mills and textile machinery manufacturers, as well as precision winding machines; and offers spare parts, and after sales services and solutions over the product life cycle. The company was founded in 1795 and is headquartered in Winterthur, Switzerland.

Ringmetall SE develops, produces, and markets packaging solutions for industrial drums in Germany and internationally. It operates through Industrial Packaging and Industrial Handling segments. The Industrial Packaging segment develops, produces, and markets packaging solutions for the drum industry. This segment also offers clamping rings, lids, seals, handles, closure units, and special components; as well as wires and strip bent parts. The Industrial Handling segment produces and markets welded assemblies, hydraulic components, lift mast parts, and clutch and brake pedals for tractors and trucks, as well as vehicle attachments and special vehicle components for freight and warehouse logistics. It also offers pipes and pipe connections; and inner liners, bag-in-box system, clamping rings, and lids. In addition, the company provides hitches for tractors, agricultural machinery and heavy-duty vehicles, and restraint systems for industrial trucks. The company serves automotive, food and beverage, chemical, petrochemical, pharmaceutical, oil and gas, building and construction, agricultural, warehouse logistics, and other industries. Ringmetall SE was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Munich, Germany.

Robertet SA produces and sells perfumes, aromas, and natural products in France, Europe, the United States, and internationally. The company operates in four segments: Raw Materials, Fragrances, Flavors, and Health & Beauty. It also offers raw materials for perfumery, food, cosmetics, and aromatherapy. Robertet SA was founded in 1850 and is headquartered in Grasse, France.

Robinson plc manufactures and sells plastic and paperboard packaging products in the United Kingdom, Poland, Denmark, Germany, Hungary, Belgium, and internationally. It offers plastic packaging, including PET, rPET, HDPE, rHDPE, PP, and LLDPE bottles; pots, tubs, and containers; caps, closures, and overcaps; jars, and custom plastic packaging. The company also provides paper packaging products, including shoulder boxes, boxes and lids, book jackets, clam packs, rigid trays and sleeves, and folding cartons. It serves the food and drink, personal care and beauty, luxury gifts, and homecare markets. The company was founded in 1839 and is based in Chesterfield, the United Kingdom.

Robit Oyj provides drilling consumables for surface mining, construction, geotechnical, and well drilling industries in Finland and internationally. The company offers hammer drilling products, such as button bits; overburden drilling bits; reaming equipment, including adapters, reamers, and dome reamers; rods, which include standard mm and mf rods, fully carburized mm and mf rods, and drifter rods; shanks; and couplings sleeves and adapters, rox and rings, and drill tubes, as well as top hammer accessories, such as guide and button bit adapters, and grinding cups. It also provides DTH drilling products comprising of hyper hammers, D-hammers, BR hammers, shock absorbers, and spare parts; DTH bits and drill pipes. In addition, the company offers casing system products, such as prime system, steel fist system, DTH Nova single-use system for down the hole hammer; overburden eccentric system, solitary ring system, and DTH-ROX Multi-Use system for down the hole hammer, as well as rotatory drill, water well, drag, air core, RC, and comet claw bits. Robit Oyj was founded in 1985 and is based in Lempäälä, Finland.

Roblon A/S develops, produces, and sells fiber solutions in Denmark and internationally. It provides cable fibers, including glass strength members, coated lines, composite reinforcement and ABC tapes, polyester binder yarns, aramid strength members, and ripcords; and cable machinery, such as servers, binders, pay offs, precision winding, caterpillars, and quick adapters for the fiber cable industry. The company offers offshore oil and gas solutions comprising orbit straps, multi straps, flex straps, clamp straps, quick straps, ratchet straps, and single and double bolt tension devices; and high voltage pulling ropes and coated lines for energy industry. In addition, it offers converting services. The company was founded in 1957 and is based in Frederikshavn, Denmark.

Romanofir SA Talmaciu manufactures sewing and needlework threads in Romania. It offers cotton, polyester, and a blend of polyester and cotton sewing threads; and cotton handwork threads. The company also provides raw yarns, including single, twisted, or cabled; and finished yarns, such as mercerized, bleached, or dyed. It serves cotton hosiery and carpet manufacturers. The company was founded in 1923 and is headquartered in Talmaciu, Romania.

Romcab SA manufactures and sells cables, electric conductors, power cords, and electric wiring in Romania. The company offers branching cables and conductors, energy cables, and reinforced energy cables for the energy networks; clam cables and galvanized steel pipes for telecommunication networks; signaling and reinforced signaling cables for railway networks; and stranded cooper wires for electrical cables and conductors that are used in the auto-motto industry, conductors for vehicles, and electrical wirings for motorbikes, automotive, OEM, and spare parts. It also provides cables for ships and railway engines, as well as for the mining industry; and cables and conductors, electrical cords, and electrical cables for electric household equipment. In addition, it offers various products for civil constructions offices and public institutions; residential, buildings apartments, and houses; and industrial constructions, assembly rooms, and deposits, which includes branching cables; conductors and cables for fixed electrical installations; flexible electrical and telecommunication cables and conductors; electrical cables and conductors for antennas; anti-theft cables; signaling and anti-fire cables in electrical installations; electrical power cords for the connection of the electrical and electro technical apparatus to the electrical charger network; and rigid cables for connection and control. The company was founded in 1950 and is headquartered in Târgu Mures, Romania. Romcab SA operates as a subsidiary of Sadalbari SRL.

Rosenbauer International AG engages in the provision of systems for preventive firefighting and disaster protection technology worldwide. It develops, produces, and sells a portfolio vehicle, fire extinguishing systems, equipment, and digital solutions for professional, industrial, plant and volunteer fire services. The company offers municipal, ARFF, and industrial and aerial rescue vehicles; aerial ladders and hydraulic firefighting, refurbishment, and rescue platforms; and intervention and limber hose reels, light masts, compartment shutters, logic control systems, roll-on/roll-off containers, and stowage systems. It also provides firefighting helmets and gloves; protective clothing and boots; power generators; fans; submersible pumps; thermal imaging cameras; nozzles; LED lighting systems; HAZMAT and decon equipment; alarms and warning devices; fittings, couplings, and proportioners; respiratory and chemical protection, and measurement technology; firefighting devices and extinguishing agents; fire station equipment; gift articles; sanitary and rescue equipment; and hoses. In addition, it offers portable pumps, ultra-high-pressure systems, POLY extinguishing systems, truck-mounted pumps, foam proportioning systems, compressed air foam systems, nozzles and monitors, turrets, and engine-pump units; DRILL-X, a drilling and extinguishing device; Rosenbauer Technical Equipment (RTE) Robot, robots for fire departments and emergency services; RFC battery extinguishing systems; RFC CUTTEX, a cutting and extinguishing system; digital solutions; CAFS, turret, and POLY extinguishing systems, tunnel protection systems; and water, gas, and kitchen extinguishing systems. Further, the company provides spare parts, and repair and general overhaul services, as well as rents vehicles and equipment. The company was founded in 1866 and is headquartered in Leonding, Austria. Rosenbauer International AG operates as a subsidiary of Rosenbauer Beteiligungsverwaltung GmbH.

Roth Mions S.A. manufactures steel cylinders and pressure tanks. The company operates in three segments. Its historical activities segment, manufacture stainless steel cylinders, industrial batteries and diving cylinders; steel domed bottoms segment, manufactures components for low-pressure storage tanks; and hydrogen segment provides tanks, smart storage solutions, eco-stations. The company serves energy and defense industries. The company was founded in 1975 is based in Mions, France. Roth Mions S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Cylinders Holding.

Rottneros AB (publ), together with its subsidiaries, develops and produces chemical and mechanical market pulp worldwide. The company offers elemental chlorine free bleached softwood sulphate pulp used for the manufacture of filters, light cartonboard products, and printing and writing papers; and unbleached kraft unbleached long-fiber sulphate pulp used for brown liquid packaging board and filters. It also provides bleached/unbleached chemi-thermo-mechanical pulp used for cartonboard, tissue, and printing and writing papers. In addition, the company manufactures molded fiber trays. Further, its products are used in various applications, such as cartonboard, filters, electrotechnical applications, fiber cement, special applications, tissue paper, and molded fiber. Rottneros AB (publ) was founded in 1887 and is based in Söderhamn, Sweden. Rottneros AB (publ) is a subsidiary of Arctic Paper S.A.

Rozachim AD produces and trades in chemical products and raw materials in Bulgaria. The company offers polymers for paper and boards, thinners, solvents, polyester resins, polyurethane paints, water treatments chemicals, olefins, intermediates, and other chemicals. It also provides polymer emulsions for interior coatings and paints; polymer emulsions for gloss paints, lacquers, and special coatings; and polymer emulsions for exterior coatings and paints. The company was founded in 1960 and is based in Gorna Oryahovitsa, Bulgaria.

RWE Aktiengesellschaft generates and supplies electricity from renewable and conventional sources in Germany, the United Kingdom, rest of Europe, North America, and internationally. It operates through five segments: Offshore Wind; Onshore Wind/Solar; Flexible Generation; Supply & Trading; and Phaseout Technologies. The company generates wind, hydro, solar, gas, lignite, and biomass electricity. It also trades in electricity, gas, and energy commodities; operates gas storage facilities; and engages in battery storage activities, as well as lignite mining and refining. The company serves commercial, industrial, and municipal customers. RWE Aktiengesellschaft was founded in 1898 and is headquartered in Essen, Germany.

Ryvu Therapeutics S.A., a clinical-stage drug discovery and development company, engages in developing of small molecule therapies for treatment in oncology in Poland, European Union, and internationally. The company’s lead candidate, Romaciclib (RVU120), is a CDK8 and CDK19 kinase inhibitor in Phase 2 clinical trial with potential to treat monotheraphy, combination therapy, monotherapy, and myelofibrosis. It also develops Dapolsertib (SEL24/MEN1703), a dual PIM and FLT3 kinase inhibitor licensed to the Menarini Group that is in study start-up for Phase 2 clinical trial for the treatment of diffuse large b-cell lymphoma and acute myeloid leukemia. In addition, the company’s early pipeline candidates include candidates in the areas of kinases, synthetic lethality, immunometabolism, and immuno-oncology. It has collaborations with BioNTech SE to advance small molecule programs to target immune modulation in cancer and other disease areas; Exelixis Inc. for the development of targeted therapies based on Ryvu’s STING agonist technology. The company was formerly known as Selvita S.A. and changed its name to Ryvu Therapeutics S.A. in October 2019. Ryvu Therapeutics S.A. was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Kraków, Poland.

S.C. ArcelorMittal Hunedoara S.A. engages in the production of ferrous metals in primary and ferrous alloy forms in Romania. It offers round billets; square and round products; and europrofiles products. The company was formerly known as SC Mittal Steel Hunedoara SA and changed its name to S.C. ArcelorMittal Hunedoara S.A. in 2006. The company was founded in 1882 and is headquartered in Hunedoara, Romania. S.C. ArcelorMittal Hunedoara S.A. is a subsidiary of ArcelorMittal Holdings AG.

S.C. Artego S.A. manufactures and sells rubber products in Romania. It provides abrasion resistant conveyor belts for general use; fire resistant conveyor belts; temperature resistant conveyor belts for conveying hot sintering materials, pellets, clinker, chemicals, fertilizers, cement, and other temperature materials; oil resistant conveyor belts with textile insertion; and oil and fire resistant conveyor belts. The company also offers fire resistant steel cord belts; conveyor belts with textile or metallic breakers; cross-stabilized conveyor belts; TPU covered conveyor belts for abrasion resistance; pipebelt conveyor belts; and Chevron and Griptop conveyor belts. In addition, it provides various rubber sheets for covering worktops, warehouses, and automobile floors, as well as for stamp gaskets, plates driving drums mounted on conveyors, etc. Further, the company offers molded and profiled rubber gaskets; and reconditioned worn drums for the food processing industry, as well as for oil and grease, heat, and mud and humidity resistance. It exports its products. It also exports its products. S.C. Artego S.A. was founded in 1973 and is headquartered in Târgu Jiu, Romania.

S.C. Braiconf S.A. manufactures and sells underwear, shirts, and other textile articles in Romania and Internationally. It offers women’s shirts, dresses, pants, nightwear, and accessories; men’s shirts, overshirts, jackets, and nightwear; bedding, children’s pajamas, and sleep kits; and robes and aprons. The company also operates as a retailer of clothing, footwear, leather goods, watches, jewelry, and other products. It sells its products in stores and online. The company was founded in 1950 and is headquartered in Bucharest, Romania. S.C. Braiconf S.A. operates as a subsidiary of French Industries SRL.

S.C. Caromet S.A. manufactures and sells railway rolling stocks, hydro-mechanical equipment, and welded assemblies in Romania. The company provides locomotive bogies and rolling stock spare parts for various types of electric, diesel, and hydraulic locomotives; and bogies for rail cars, tramways, and undergrounds, as well as overhauls for various types of bogies. It also offers steel constructions for industrial buildings and boilers; cut-off plates, cofferdams, embedded parts, and racks; and welded assemblies, such as steel structures, casings, gas ducts, lifting devices, and railway and road bridges. The company was founded in 1969 and is based in Caransebes, Romania. S.C. Caromet S.A. is a subsidiary of S.C. Iasitex S.A.

S.C. Confectii Vaslui S.A. produces and sells ready-made garments in Romania. It offers various outwear products, including casual and sportswear line products, such as jackets, blousons, anoraks, car coats, raincoats, and waistcoats for men, ladies, and children; and tailoring line products comprising jackets, skirts, trousers, and suits for ladies. The company also exports its products to Germany, the United Kingdom, Italy, France, Sweden, and the United States. S.C. Confectii Vaslui S.A. was founded in 1965 and is based in Vaslui, Romania.

S.C. Conted S.A. manufactures, trades in, and sells textiles wear for men, women, and children in Romania and internationally. It offers man suits, man coats, man trousers, man overcoats, woman overcoats, woman skirts, woman trousers, woman jackets, woman suits, military uniforms, vests, child jackets, and child overcoats under Bleu Marine, Sam Daniel, Progetto Uomo, and Samiolli brand names. The company also exports its products. S.C. Conted S.A. was founded in 1963 and is headquartered in Dorohoi, Romania.

company: S.C. De Reparat Material Rulant Reva S.A.
business_description: S.C. De Reparat Material Rulant Reva S.A. engages in the construction and repair of rolling stock in Romania and Europe. The company is involved in the design, manufacturing, modernization, and repair of railway wagons; manufacturing and reconditioning of rolling stock spare parts; manufacturing of metallic structures and other industrial products; installation of civilian and industrial constructions, SDVs, forged and molded parts, accessories for machine tools, and oxygen bottling, as well as execution of stands; and casting of parts from cast iron and steel. It also engages in import and export activities, as well as trading of rolling stock and raw materials and products. The company was founded in 1869 and is headquartered in Simeria, Romania. S.C. De Reparat Material Rulant Reva S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Grampet S.A.

S.C. Emailul S.A. manufactures and markets household enamel pots in Romania and internationally. The company also offers dishes and other household items made of sheet steel, enameled with different types of enamels, various resistances and colors, and decorations. The company was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Medias, Romania.

S.C. Fimaro S.A. engages in the manufacture and sale of metal constructions and component parts of metal structures in Romania. The company offers dryers for metal packaging for the food industry; components and assemblies for production lines in the metallurgical industry; components and assemblies for automotive and materials recycling industries, as well as for air treatment and purification for ventilation and air conditioning units; and complex metal construction for the chemical, food, cement, and material recycling industries. It also provides technological design, laser and oxy-acetylene cuttings, mechanical processing on computer numerical control and conventional machines, bending, forming, ring-forming, guillotining, and sandblasting and painting, as well as MIG, TIG, ARC, and plasma welding. The company was founded in 1924 and is headquartered in Cluj-Napoca, Romania. S.C. Fimaro S.A. is a subsidiary of Icpiaf S.A. - Cluj Napoca.

S.C. Galfinband S.A. produces and sells steel products in Romania and internationally. The company offers cold rolled steel strips; pickled and galvanized sheet metal; metallic coated steel strips; corrosion-protected strapping bands; galvanized clamps for stapling straps; profiles for plasterboard systems; PVC carpentry reinforcement profiles; and powder-filled steel tubes. It is also involved in research, design, development, execution, and operation of technologic installations, as well as industrial automation and communication systems. S.C. Galfinband S.A. was founded in 1984 and is based in Galati, Romania.

S.C. Iasitex S.A. manufactures and sells fabrics and textile confections in Romania. The company offers weaved fabrics for bed linen, table clothes and other textile accessories, kitchen towels and bathrobes, individual work and protection wear, textile interior decorations, and other household and specific technical use; ready-to-wear individual work and protection clothes; and ready-made textiles for interior decorations and other household use. S.C. Iasitex S.A. was formerly known as Întreprinderea de Stat Tesatura Iasi and changed its name to S.C. Iasitex S.A. in 1990. The company was founded in 1910 and is based in Bucharest, Romania. S.C. Iasitex S.A. operates as a subsidiary of A2 Impex SRL.

S.C. Iproeb S.A. manufactures and sells electrical products in Romania and internationally. The company produces and markets aluminum, aluminum-steel, and galvanized steel conductors; copper or aluminum cables and conductors, insulated in PVC and polyethylene; electrically insulating materials; composite insulators; automation equipment and other various electrical equipment. It offers Cables for wind and solar farms, such as low voltage cables with PVS insulation, XLPE insulated low voltage, medium voltage, and solar cables; electric conductors, including aluminum, steel-aluminum alloy, and galvanized steel conductors, as well as wooden cable drums; signaling and control cables, power cables for low voltage (LV) and medium voltage (MV); insulated electrical cables for energy, railway, telecommunications, and automotive industries; copper, aluminum conductors, and flexible cables for electrical installations; testing laboratory services; composite insulators, insulator chains, metal fittings, horns, and protective rings; and automation tools. S.C. Iproeb S.A. was founded in 1977 and is headquartered in Bistrita, Romania.

S.C. Macofil S.A. produces and supplies a range of construction materials in Romania. It offers ceramic blocks and precast concrete products. The company also provides ceramic product, including brick; prefabricated products, such as electrical poles, sewer pipes, paving blocks of various shapes and colors, and mortar and fresh concrete, as well as elements for bridges and footbridges; and ballast aggregates products. S.C. Macofil S.A. was founded in 1991 and is based in Târgu Jiu, Romania.

S.C. Mecon S.A. manufactures metal fabrication and structure components in Romania. The company offers industrial and civil hall components; steel and stainless-steel metal pipes; sorting station components, including vibrating screens, screw classifiers, sand washers, conveyor belts, feeding, hopper metal meshes, and spare parts; small metal products, such as presentation stands, perforated panels, modular shelves, trolleys, awnings, and metal gates; and PVC and aluminum joinery products, as well as machinery and equipment for quarries and ballast pits. It also provides various construction works comprising cutting with plasma and guillotine cutting machines, bending on numerically controlled machines, sandblasting, classic and electrostatic field painting, and welding with authorized personnel. S.C. Mecon S.A. was founded in 1949 and is headquartered in Brasov, Romania.

S.C. Metalul Mesa S.A. engages in the steel processing business in Romania and the European Union. The company provides forged and machined parts, tools, and trailers. It also provides forging, heat treatment, sandblasting, and mechanical processing services. The company serves the agro-industry, industrial valve, industrial equipment, metal structure and transportation, and metal construction sectors. It exports its products. S.C. Metalul Mesa S.A. was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Salonta, Romania.

S.C. PETAL S.A. manufactures and sells oil field equipment, valves, industrial valves, and metallurgical equipment primarily in Romania. The company offers cementing and fracturing units, including butterfly valves, duplex pumps with pistons, triplex plunger pumps, water pumps, 4 in valves, and plug valves; and wellheads, Christmas trees, casing head housings, casing head spools, tubing heads, pack-off flanges, adjustable and positive chokes, expanding parallel gate valves with nonrising and rising stem, and FC model gate valves for gas and oil. It also provides valves and chokes for neutral and low corrosive media, such as adjustable and positive flaged chokes, cast steel ball valves, check valves with piston, expanding parallel gate valves with rising stem, flexible wedge gate valves, RSDM and RSDF type straight gate valves, and straight globe valves; and spare parts for cementing units and mud pumps comprising triplex plunger pump 3 PU 20, monobloc pistons type I, II, III, mud pumps liners, mud pumps valves, piston rods, removable gaskets pistons, rotary type chain, and UNIPET triplex pumps. The company also exports its products to the United Kingdom, Germany, the Czech Republic, Slovakia, Turkey, Russia, Ukraine, Belarus, Uzbekistan, Azerbaidjan, Turkmenistan, India, China, etc. S.C. PETAL S.A. was founded in 1949 and is based in Husi, Romania.

S.C. Prebet Aiud S.A. produces and sells prestressed ferro-concrete and concrete prefabs for construction works. It offers prefabricated elements for railway, including railway concrete sleepers, pipe culvert prefabs, support and protection prefabs for railway, prefabs for rolling stock revision channel, and railway crossing prefabs. The company also provides causeway structure elements, such as viaduct girders, pipe culvert prefabs for roads, support and protection prefabs, and prefabricated for platforms. In addition, it offers concrete sleepers for railways; prestressed concrete beams for road and railways bridges; prefabricated bridges for railway and road bridges; gantry beams for road bridges with large spans; precast concrete for art works and tunnels; tiles for railway level crossings; prefabricated channel with pockets for overhauling locomotives and wagons; reinforced concrete sleepers for subways and trams; and various prefabricated parts for structures. S.C. Prebet Aiud S.A. was founded in 1904 and is headquartered in Aiud, Romania.

S.C. Romcarbon S.A., together with its subsidiaries, operates as a plastic processor in Romania, Europe, China, Israel, Taiwan, and Panama. The company offers air, cabin, fuel, and oil filters; granular and powder active carbon; basic foil, folded sheet for packing and thermo shrinkable covers, general use polyethylene film, constructions film, black film for mulch, premium UV solar 3 year film, transparent film for the plant germination, UV Solar, coated/uncoated polypropylene fabric, PP strap, thick and thin sacks and bags, uncoated polypropylene bags, one and two loop big bag, polypropylene coated bags, polypropylene bags with PE liner, and four loop big bag; and extruded PS standard and absorbant tray, food packaging, and PET rigid packaging. It also provides XPS panel/insulation underlament; Q-Bag, PP threads, yarn, and fabric; polypropylene bags with valve and strapping tape; recycled polymers rPP, rPE, rPS, and rABS, as well as plastic compounds; bio compostable shopping bag, bio compostable vegetable bag/fruit bag, recyclable waste collection bag, and bio compostable bag for organic waste; PVC support for road sign; and PP straps. In addition, the company is involved in the provision of plumbing, heat, and air conditioning installation; business and other management consultancy, other information technology and computer service, sport facilities, and other financial service activities; manufacture of products for the human health. Its products are used for agriculture, automotive, construction and home improvement, filtration and protection masks, slaughterhouse and food processing, horeca, packaging, plastic processing, and printing house applications. The company was founded in 1952 and is headquartered in Buzau, Romania.

S.C. Severnav S.A. manufactures and repairs maritime and river vessels in Romania. The company provides inland passenger ships, chemical tankers, gas carriers, general cargo ships, river pushers and tugboats, barges, leisure boats and yachts, and life and rescue boats; offshore support vessels, exploration vessels, and construction ships; and container ships, multipurpose container vessels, tanker ships, bulk carriers, and special vessels. It also offers government/scientific research and military vessels, and fire boats; and trawlers, longliners, and crabbers. In addition, the company provides ship repair services, such as hull parts; tanks and cargo holds cleaning and painting works; repair or replacing of chests and strainers; cathodic protection; anchors; chains and chain lockers; valves; rudders; tail-shaft and stern tube works; steel structure renewal services; cutting and welding works; machining parts; mechanical and electrical works; piping works; surface treatments; grit and hydro blasting services; other types of cleaning work facilities; airless painting works; and outfitting works. Further, it converts single hull tankers into double hull tankers, and oil tankers into bulk carriers; merchandise barges into others; and vessel adaptation from the initial uses into others, as well as provides damage repair services comprising collisions or groundings. S.C. Severnav S.A. was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Drobeta-Turnu Severin, România.

S.C. Transilana S.A. produces and sells yarns in Romania. It offers yarns for industrial knitting, industrial weaving, hand knitting and crocheting; and wool tops/roving for wool tops. The company was founded in 1936 and is headquartered in Brasov, Romania.

S.C. UAMT S.A. manufactures and sells other parts and accessories for motor vehicles and motor vehicle engines in Europe and internationally. Its products portfolio includes exterior mirrors, seat parts, pedal systems, hand brakes, control cable rods, wheel wrenches, stamped and injected parts, and pedalier sports; and locks, windshield wipers, rods, door locks, brackets, and lifting jacks. S.C. UAMT S.A. was founded in 1951 and is based in Oradea, Romania.

S.C. Vitimas S.A. is involved in the production and marketing of machinery and spare parts. The company offers products for agriculture and the food industry, metal constructions and components, steel machinery, various collaborations and services. S.C. Vitimas S.A. was founded in 1951 and is headquartered in Tecuci, Romania.

As of December 3, 2003, SAIAG S.p.A was acquired by Cortiplast Spa. SAIAG S.p.A operates in the aluminum rolling, and electric power cables and cords sectors in Europe. The company markets its products under the brand names, Cuki and Domopak. It operates in three segments: Consumer Products, Aluminum Rolled Products, and Cords and Cables. Consumer Products segment operates in the domestic and industrial market, with wrappers, food packages, and housecleaning products. Its products are marketed to food industries, airlines catering, private and public catering, self-consumption for large distributions, and gastronomy shops. Aluminum Rolled Products segment produces thin and semi-thin aluminum foils, and flexible packaging and metalloplastic yarns. Its customers include food package producers and large food companies. Cords and Cables segment produces and markets bare copper conductors; enameled copper wires; insulated cables in rubber, PVC, and polyurethane; and cords fitted with plugs and moulded connectors. SAIAG was established in 1935.

SaltX Technology Holding AB (publ) engages in the development and sale of sustainable technology in Sweden. It offers electric arc calciner, a technology where fossil-driven heating is replaced with renewable electricity and separate the CO2 emissions released during the heating process. The company’s technology is used in quicklime, cement production, energy storage, and carbon dioxide capture, as well as in production of aluminum and magnesium. SaltX Technology Holding AB (publ) was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Hägersten, Sweden.

Salzgitter AG, together with its subsidiaries, engages in steel and technology businesses worldwide. The company operates through four segments: Steel Production, Steel Processing, Trading, and Technology. Its Steel Production segment manufactures steel and special steels, such as hot-rolled wide strip, steel sheet, sections, tailored blanks, as well as scrap trading. The Steel Processing segment produces various high-grade heavy plate products; and manufactures line pipes, HFI-welded tubes, and precision tubes. Its Trading segment operates a European sales network, as well as trading companies and agencies worldwide. The Technology segment engages in the provision of machinery and plants for the filling and packaging of beverages, as well as special machinery engineering for elastomer production. It also provides IT, facility management, logistics, automotive engineering, and research and development services, as well as supplies raw materials. The company was founded in 1858 and is headquartered in Salzgitter, Germany.

Sanderson Design Group plc, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the design, manufacture, marketing, and distribution of interior furnishings, fabrics, and wallpapers worldwide. The company operates in three segments: Brands, Licensing, and Manufacturing. The Brands segment designs, markets, sells, and distributes home accessories, wallcoverings, textiles, wooden printing blocks, bedlinen, paint, tableware, rugs, towels, tableware, bathroom accessories, trimmings, carpets, and furniture under the Morris & Co., Sanderson, Zoffany, Clarke & Clarke, Harlequin, and Scion brands. The Licensing segment engages in the licensing of Morris & Co., Sanderson, Zoffany, Clarke & Clarke, Harlequin, and Scion brands. The Manufacturing segment manufactures wallcoverings and printed fabrics. The company was formerly known as Walker Greenbank PLC and changed its name to Sanderson Design Group plc in November 2020. Sanderson Design Group plc was founded in 1860 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.

Sandoz Group AG develops, manufactures, and markets generic and biosimilars worldwide. The company covers therapeutic areas, including cardiovascular, central nervous system, oncology, infectious diseases, pain and respiratory, supportive care, rare diseases, diabetes, immunology, endocrinology, neurology, osteoporosis, nephrology, hematology, and ophthalmology. It also provides a portfolio of active pharmaceutical ingredients and finished dosage forms. Sandoz Group AG was founded in 1886 and is headquartered in Basel, Switzerland.

Saniona AB (publ), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, focuses on discovering, developing, and delivering innovative treatments for neurological and psychiatric disorders in Ireland, the United States, Germany, Denmark, and the United Kingdom. It also develops medicines modulating ion channels. The company’s product includes Tesofensine, a monoamine reuptake inhibitor that has completed Phase 3 clinical trial to treat people with obesity; and Tesomet, an oral investigational therapy that has completed Phase 2 clinical trial for the treatment of hypothalamic obesity and Prader-Willi syndrome; ACP-711, a positive allosteric modulator of GABAA a3 containing receptors that has completed Phase 1 clinical trial for the treatment of essential tremor; SAN903, a novel medicine based on inhibition of the calcium-activated potassium ion channel, which has completed preclinical development for the treatment of inflammatory bowel disease; SAN2219, a subtype selective positive allosteric modulator of GABAA a2- a3- and a5 that is in preclinical stage for treatment of acute repetitive seizures; SAN2355 to treat resistant focal onset seizures; SAN2668, a therapy for severe pediatric epilepsies, including developmental epileptic encephalopathies; and SAN2465, a negative allosteric modulator to treat major depressive disorder. It has research and collaboration agreements with Boehringer Ingelheim International GmbH to research, develop, manufacture, and commercialize therapeutics; license agreement with Productos Medix, S.A. de C.V. develop and commercialize tesofensine and/or Tesomet; research services agreement and a collaboration agreement with Cephagenix ApS to identify and develop novel migraine treatments; and research collaboration with AstronauTx to research, develop, manufacture, and commercialize therapeutics for Alzheimer’s disease. The company was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Glostrup, Denmark.

Sanok Rubber Company Spólka Akcyjna engages in the production and sale of rubber products in Poland, Germany, France, Finland, Hungary, Ukraine, and Belarus. The company operates through five segments: Automotive, Construction, Agriculture and Industry, Rubber Mixtures, and Other. It offers rubber, rubber-metal, rubber-plastic, and elastomer products; thermoplastic TPEs for body sealing and car suspension systems, as well as exhaust system suspensions; sealing systems used in the production of window and door joinery, and gutter and ventilation systems; and self-adhesive seals used for sealing in installed joinery and aluminum substructures for ventilated facades. The company also provides V-belts and accessories under the Harvest Belts, Garden Belts, Vege Belts, and OptimumPro brands; stoppers for closing glass vials and plastic packaging with antibiotics, infusion fluids, and blood products; plungers for disposable syringes; and rubber products for household appliances, industrial hoses, and molded products for protecting industrial equipment against wear and corrosion. In addition, it is involved in the provision of repairs of machines and devices, sanatorium, recreation, and industrial services; and manufacturing of equipment to produce rubber and plastic products. The company was formerly known as Stomil Sanok S.A. and changed its name to Sanok Rubber Company Spólka Akcyjna in November 2015. Sanok Rubber Company Spólka Akcyjna was founded in 1932 and is headquartered in Sanok, Poland.

Santhera Pharmaceuticals Holding AG, a specialty pharmaceutical company, together with its subsidiaries, develops and sells medicines for rare neuromuscular and pulmonary diseases with high unmet medical need in the Europe, North America, and Asia. The company’s lead pipeline candidate includes Vamorolone, which is developed for the treatments of Duchenne muscular dystrophy. Santhera Pharmaceuticals Holding AG was founded in 2004 and is based in Pratteln, Switzerland.

Santierul Naval Constanta S.A. provides ship building and repair services in Romania and internationally. The company offers cutting equipment machines and plant; welding equipment and welding methods; lifting and piping equipment; machining equipment and tools; and investment programs. It also builds bulk carriers, chemical products tankers, container vessels, crude oil tankers, general cargo vessels, and special vessels. In addition, the company provides repair works, including dry-dock works comprising hull, tanks and cargo holds cleaning and painting, blasting and hydro blasting to various grades, repair or replacing of sea chest and strainers, cathodic protection, anchors, chains and chain lockers, valves, rudder, tailshaft, and stern tube; surface treatment application for cargo holds and cargo tanks; extensive steelworks renewal; mechanical and electrical works; piping replacement and new piping system installation; overhauling of any type of mainn and auxiliary engines, such as parts reconditioning; and overhauling of any type of turbo chargers. Further, it is involved in conversions and special projects. The company was founded in 1892 and is based in Constanta, Romania. Santierul Naval Constanta S.A. is a subsidiary of Resource International SA.

Sareum Holdings plc, a clinical stage small molecule drug development company, engages in the discovery and development of therapeutic drugs for cancer and autoimmune diseases. The company’s lead product is SDC-1801, a TYK2/JAK1 inhibitor which has completed Phase 1 clinical trial for the treatment of autoimmune diseases. It also develops SDC-1802, a TYK2/JAK1 inhibitor, that is in preclinical stage for cancer and cancer-immunotherapy applications; and SRA737, a clinical-stage oral, selective Chk 1 inhibitor, which has completed Phase II clinical trials that targets cancer cell replication and DNA damage repair mechanisms. The company has strategic collaboration with Receptor.AI launched in August 2025 to accelerate discovery and optimisation of BBB-permeable TYK2/JAK1 inhibitors; and completion of initial stage expected Q4 2025. Sareum Holdings plc was formerly known as Keepfast plc and changed its name to Sareum Holdings plc in July 2004. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Cambridge, the United Kingdom.

Saxlund Group AB (publ), an environmental technology group, develops, manufactures, and services plants and equipment for the production of environmental-friendly and resource-efficient energy. The company provides push floor dischargers, sliding frame silo dischargers, tube-feeder biomass reclaimers, hydraulic rotor silo dischargers, trailer docking stations, transportable biomass centres, chain conveyors, screw conveyors, and solids pump products. It also offers complete power station handling system, reception of material from trucks, silo storage and discharge systems, truck loading system, and biomass large scale storage system. The company serves cement, electricity, heat and power production, wood and forest, water and waste management, process, recycling, mining, and other industries. The company was formerly known as Pilum AB (publ.) and changed its name to Saxlund Group AB (publ) in July 2017. Saxlund Group AB (publ) was founded in 1947 and is headquartered in Nacka, Sweden.

SBO AG manufactures and sells steel products worldwide. The company operates in two segments, Precision Technology and Energy Equipment. It offers high-strength non-magnetic steels and precision components; advanced additive manufacturing; service and repair; energy equipment, such as high-performance drilling motors; rotary steerable tools; circulation tools; and well-completion solutions. SBO AG was formerly known as Schoeller-Bleckmann Oilfield Equipment Aktiengesellschaft and changed its name to SBO AG in July 2025. The company was founded in 1862 and is headquartered in Ternitz, Austria.

SC Aages SA designs, manufactures, and sells induction heating machines in Romania and internationally. The company offers VHM type vertical hardening machines, HHM type horizontal hardening machines, chain hardening equipment, pipe hardening equipment, and bar hardening equipment. It also provides steel and iron alloys melting equipment in tilting furnaces; copper and copper alloys melting equipment in tilting and push-out furnaces; aluminium and aluminium alloys melting equipment; and small capacity furnaces for laboratory and research purposes. In addition, the company offers mass heating for metal processing. The company was founded in 1990 and is based in Mures, Romania. SC Aages SA is a subsidiary of Aages Headinvest SRL.

SC Arteca Jilava SA manufactures and sells rubber products. It offers conveyor belts with textile inserts, technical plates, and trapezoidal belts; short, medium and long belts; variator belts for agricultural machinery; hoses products; brake hoses; pressed and profiled gaskets; products for military equipment and materials; food and sanitary products; ebonite articles, such as battery boxes and covers; and rubber plastics. The company also provides technical assistance and repairs of technical rubber items, technical assistance for installation and commissioning of rubber processing capacities, assembly of metal heads at hoses, development and sale of rubber processing technologies, and training personnel in the field of rubber processing. SC Arteca Jilava SA was founded in 1955 and is headquartered in Jilava, Romania.

SC IAMU SA manufactures and sells accessories and replacement components for machine tools in Romania. Its products include tool holders for CNC machine tools, molds, vices, guides, and manual tools. The company also provides accessories for machine tools; and parts for medical technology, packaging machines, linear technique, injection molding machines, and scrap binding machines. In addition, it offers treatment plants for coolants and products according to customer’s documentation. The company was founded in 1972 and is based in Blaj, Romania.

SC IUS SA engages in the production and marketing of hand tools for industry, construction, and automotive sectors in Romania. It offers steel jacks; workshop equipment and storage; ratchets and sockets; opening wrenches; torque tools; screwdrivers and hexagonal keys; pliers, shears, and bolt cutters; sawing and cutting products; rasps, files, and woodworking tools; measuring products; industrial/blacksmithing tools; plumber and maintenance products; vices; gasket cutters; non-sparking tools; earthworks; bricklayer; roofer; drywallers; bricklayer; facade builder; concrete slab maker; tiler; trestle and workbench; handling assistance, measuring, tracing, cutting, and multi-trade tools; protection of the worksite; building site cleaning products; wood construction; soil cultivation and wood splitting tools; and structural works, snow removal, and replacement handle products under the MOB, Mondelin, IUS, and Leborgne brands. The company was founded in 1833 and is headquartered in Brasov, Romania. SC IUS SA operates as a subsidiary of MOB Mondelin.

SC Minexfor SA produces and sells soft drinks and bottled water in Romania. The company offers natural mineral water under the Perla Apusenilor brand. It is also involved in the maintaining and repairing of vehicles; trading and retailing of parts and accessories for motor vehicles; technical car inspections; technical testing and analysis; space rentals; provision of automobile services, including mechanical work, tinsmithing, painting authorized ITP station, truck rim replacement and alignment, cold and hot vulcanization, tubes and tires, 3D wheel geometry, computerized diagnosis, and car wash services; and water drilling activities. SC Minexfor SA was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Deva, Romania.

Scana ASA provides technology and services for the offshore and energy industries in Norway, other European countries, the United States, Asia, and Africa. It operates in two segments: Energy and Offshore. The company offers stress joints, mooring systems, actuators, bop, risers, maintenace, and surface treatment products; and energy storage solutions, shore power, and energy modules. It also provides product and service portfolio, including design and integration of electrical power systems, electrical infrastructure, energy storage systems, and control system. In addition, the company is involved in design and manufacturing of riser applications and specialist subsea equipment to rig servicing; ISS services; mooring systems; IMR lifecycle services for rigs and vessels; and mooring solutions and valve control systems to the shipping, energy, and aquaculture industry. Scana ASA was formerly known as Incus Investor ASA and changed its name to Scana ASA in May 2020. The company was founded in 1976 and is headquartered in Bergen, Norway.

Scancell Holdings plc, a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company, discovers and develops of immunotherapies for the treatment of cancer in the United Kingdom. Its product candidates include SCIB1/iSCIB1+ that is in Phase II for the treatment of melanoma; and SC134, an antibody for the treatment of small cell lung cancer. It also develops Modi-1, an active peptide immunotherapy that is in phase II clinical trials for the treatment of solid tumors, including renal, head and neck, ovarian and triple negative breast cancers; and Modi-2, which targets stress-induced post translational modifications, such as homocittrullination. In addition, the company provides GlyMab platform that generates various affinity tumour specific monoclonal antibodies (mAb) targeting glycans that are over-expressed on cancer cells; and AvidiMab, which romotes receptor clustering thereby improving immune signalling. Scancell Holdings plc was founded in 1996 and is based in Oxford, the United Kingdom.

Schaeffler AG, together with its subsidiaries, develops, manufactures, and sells components and systems for industrial applications in Europe, the Americas, China, and the Asia Pacific. It operates through E-Mobility, Powertrain and Chassis, Vehicle Lifetime Solutions, Bearings & Industrial Solutions divisions. The E-Mobility division offers mechanical, mechatronic, and electronic components and systems for powertrain electrification used in passenger cars and commercial vehicles. It includes electric drives, controls, and mechatronics and modules, as well as battery components, decoupling units, and wet clutches. The Powertrain & Chassis division develops, manufactures, and distributes components and system solutions for electrified powertrains and internal combustion engine, as well as chassis and steering technologies. This segment also provides engine and transmission systems, powertrain solutions, and chassis systems; torque converters, hybrid dampers, clutches, variable valve train systems, valve-lash adjustment elements, balancer shafts, camshaft phasing systems, timing drives, and front end auxiliary drives. The Vehicle Lifetime Solutions division offers components and repair solutions for passenger cars, light and heavy commercial vehicles, tractors, and two-wheelers. The Bearings & Industrial Solutions division develops, manufactures, and distributes rotary and linear bearing solutions, drive components and systems for industrial automation sectors, and service solutions. The company has a strategic technology partnership with Hexagon Robotics for the development and supply of high-precision strain wave and planetary gear actuators. The company also has strategic partnership with Spire Global, Inc. to develop space hardware subsystems, satellite platforms, and advanced radiofrequency (RF) and environmental sensing capabilities. The company was formerly known as INA Beteiligungsgesellschaft mit beschränkter Haftung and changed its name to Schaeffler AG in October 2014. Schaeffler AG was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in Herzogenaurach, Germany. Schaeffler AG is a subsidiary of IHO Verwaltungs GmbH.

Schloss Wachenheim AG produces and distributes sparkling and semi-sparkling wine products in Europe, France, Poland, Romania, the Czech Republic, Slovakia, and Great.
